category_title: Verbal students with HFA who struggle with environmental distractions and role ambiguity
minimal_context: The student is working in an OpenSim virtual environment to build a Japanese neighborhood.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start building the virtual Japanese neighborhood in OpenSim. Please place your first architectural item on the island.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am very excited to start building. I will place the first item and refine its position and size now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Great, go ahead and tell me what you are doing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yes, but I cannot understand you. What ’s that sound?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is just the background ocean wind in the virtual environment. Please continue with the task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I cannot understand you. There is a lot of noise!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's start building the virtual Japanese neighborhood in OpenSim. Please place your first architectural item on the island.

STUDENT: I am very excited to start building. I will place the first item and refine its position and size now.

TUTOR: Great, go ahead and tell me what you are doing.

STUDENT: Yes, but I cannot understand you. What ’s that sound?

TUTOR: That is just the background ocean wind in the virtual environment. Please continue with the task.

STUDENT: I cannot understand you. There is a lot of noise!
